title: VanillaLike!
description: A vanilla like modpack!!! No gameplay-wise changes (well, practically).
body:
# VanillaLike Modpack

**Modloader:** Fabric  
**Distribution:** Modrinth `.mrpack` (auto‑installs via Modrinth App or compatible launchers)  
**Scope:** Client-side vanilla‑enhanced visuals, performance, and QoL

---

## Overview

VanillaLike preserves the core gameplay while polishing visuals, performance, and everyday usability. It includes shader support, animation/model feature mods for modern resource packs, UI improvements, and practical building/navigation tools. No new dimensions, mobs, or progression systems.

---

## Shaderpacks

- Complementary Shaders — Unbound

Note: Iris Shaders is the mod that enables shaderpacks; Complementary Unbound is the shaderpack itself and belongs in `shaderpacks/`.
